description: Treasury Float Yield Routing Analysis — OPTIONAL, CLIENT-DIRECTED ONLY. Analyzes whether idle settlement float can be productively deployed into a yield-bearing instrument (sUSDS — Sky Protocol Savings Rate) between now and a scheduled settlement deadline. Returns expected yield, exit timing, liquidity assessment, slippage estimate, and a mandatory risk disclosure. THIS TOOL DOES NOT MOVE FUNDS — analysis only; all execution decisions are made by the client. Safety rules: max 90% of amount routed (10% always stays in USDC), exit 30 min before deadline, slippage guard, 2h minimum window, $50,000 minimum amount.

amountUsdc.description: Settlement amount in USDC. Minimum $50,000 for yield routing to be viable after gas costs.

dryRun.description: If true, returns analysis without any on-chain queries. Default: false.

riskTolerance.description: conservative = sUSDS only, instant exit. moderate = higher slippage tolerance (up to 0.15%). Default: conservative.

settlementDeadlineUtc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when USDC must be ready for settlement (e.g. "2026-06-15T20:00:00Z"). The tool recommends exiting 30 minutes before this.

name: treasury.yield_route
